purpose: Teach: マタイ/カンジ/エッセンス/面々/国崎/土屋/大森/樋口

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、宗教団体マタイ派の捜査を、警察、慎重におこなわれますね
lines.en: In this case, the police are conducting the investigation into the Matthew sect with considerable care, aren't they.
lines.style: Measured, observational tone. Slightly formal register befitting a university student speaking respectfully to an officer. Steady pacing, no rush. A genuine question posed as statement.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、調書のカンジ、つまり漢字の誤記にも注意されますね
lines.en: The police are also paying close attention to the details in the statements—even things like kanji characters being miswritten, I imagine.
lines.style: Steady, collaborative. Acknowledging Ren's point with professional precision. Calm, unhurried delivery. A gentle confirmation that speaks from experience.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者の供述のエッセンス、つまり要点を、警察、整理されますね
lines.en: In this case, I imagine the police are organizing the essential points from what the suspect has said—sorting through all of it carefully.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly probing. Deliberate pacing. Ren is checking his understanding, not lecturing. Warm curiosity underneath the formal phrasing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、捜査本部の面々と毎朝会議されますね
lines.en: Yes—the investigation team and I have morning briefings every single day to keep everything coordinated.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, grounded in routine. No dramatics. The voice of someone describing the actual work. Steady eye contact level in the tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、国崎半島の事件を、警察、地元署と連携されますね
lines.en: In this case, the police are working together with the local precinct on the Kunisaki Peninsula incident, I expect.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly formal. Ren is thinking through the logistics aloud. Gentle curiosity. Respectful but not deferential—genuine wonder about procedure.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、参考人土屋氏のご証言を、警察、丁寧に伺われますね
lines.en: We're being quite careful in listening to what the witness Tsuchiya has to say—we want to hear it all properly.
lines.style: Warm professionalism. Officer Takeda is explaining without condescension. Measured pace. The reassurance that this witness will be treated with real care.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、貝塚研究の大森氏に、警察、ご助言を仰がれますね
lines.en: I imagine the police are also seeking advice from Omori, who specializes in shell-mound research—he might have insights we'd miss.
lines.style: Genuinely respectful inquiry. Ren is piecing together how specialists fit into an investigation. Steady, unpressured delivery. A student thinking out loud with someone who will take it seriously.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、被害者樋口氏のご家族にも、警察、慎重に対応されますね
lines.en: We're handling everything with the victim Higuchi's family very carefully—that's something we take extremely seriously.
lines.style: Tender underneath the professional tone. Officer Takeda's voice softens slightly here. This is where the work touches real grief. Careful pacing, respect in every syllable.
